roles.title: Cybersecurity Penetration Tester
roles.summary: Leading comprehensive security assessments for enterprise applications serving fintech companies, banking institutions, and international organizations.
highlights: Conduct end-to-end Web Application Penetration Testing across enterprise platforms, validating findings with manual techniques and proof-of-concept development.
Perform API Security Assessments covering authentication, authorization, and business-logic flaws in mission-critical services.
Execute Mobile Application Security Testing on iOS and Android targets, including traffic analysis and binary review.
Carry out Thick Client and Network Penetration Testing across production and staging infrastructure.
Deliver structured reporting with risk analysis, remediation guidance, and client-ready technical documentation.
Align assessments with OWASP Top 10, secure development principles, and industry best practices.

roles.title: Security Analyst — VAPT
roles.summary: Supported offensive security engagements, strengthening methodology and reporting quality while communicating directly with clients.
highlights: Performed Vulnerability Assessments and manual security testing for web and network assets.
Participated in Source Code Review engagements to identify security defects early in the SDLC.
Conducted black-box and gray-box testing, mapping results against OWASP Top 10.
Collaborated with clients on remediation strategies and produced technical documentation.
Practiced responsible disclosure and continuous learning across offensive security domains.
